transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
I guess… I’ve just been feeling really restless. Like I can’t settle in my own body, especially when I’m supposed to sit quietly and deal with paperwork or household planning stuff. It’s been hard.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot about different things in your life, like work, family, or everyday responsibilities, even when there isn’t a clear reason to be concerned?
I’m not sure… I mean, I think about things I need to do, but I wouldn’t say I’m worrying all the time for no reason. Not that I’ve really noticed.
Have you noticed feeling tired or lacking energy, even if you haven’t been doing much physically or mentally taxing?
Not really, no. I mean, I get tired like anyone does, but I haven’t noticed it being a big thing when I haven’t done much.
Do you find it hard to control this restlessness, like you can’t stop moving or staying focused on tasks even if you try?

Yeah… I think so. It’s like I try to sit still and just get through paperwork or talk through household plans, but I feel… unsettled in my body. Like I can’t really make myself calm down and stay with it.
Do you often feel anxious or on edge about various things in your life, even when there isn’t an immediate problem?
I don’t think so… not really. I mean, I get stressed sometimes, but I wouldn’t say I’m usually on edge when nothing’s actually happening.
Do you ever feel unusually tired or low on energy even when you haven’t been doing anything particularly hard or stressful?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I get tired sometimes, but not in that unusual way you’re asking about.
Do you find it hard to concentrate or stay focused on tasks, even when you're trying to pay attention?

Yes… that does happen. I’ll sit down with something, like a planning email or a book, and I start off okay. Then a few minutes later I’m just staring at the same paragraph and realize I didn’t really take any of it in.
Do you find it hard to focus or feel restless in other situations besides when you're dealing with paperwork or household planning—like at work, in conversations, or during leisure activities?

Yeah… I think so. It’s mostly when I’m supposed to sit still and deal with paperwork or planning things at home. I just feel like I can’t really settle in my own body. I get restless, like I need to move or do something else.
Do you find it hard to focus or feel restless in situations other than when you're doing paperwork or planning things at home, like at work, during conversations, or while trying to relax?

Mostly it’s that same kind of thing… when I’m supposed to sit quietly and deal with paperwork or household plans. I just feel like I can’t settle in my own body. I’m not sure I notice it as much in other situations.
Do you ever feel restless or have trouble focusing when you’re not dealing with paperwork or household planning, like during meetings, conversations, or when you’re trying to relax?

Yeah… I guess in things like church meetings or family dinners. I’ll be sitting there trying to seem normal, but I’m twisting my wedding ring or bouncing my foot, shifting around in the chair. I don’t always notice it right away.
Do you find it hard to stay focused or feel restless even during activities that you enjoy, like watching TV, reading for fun, or talking with friends?

Yeah… sometimes. Like if my husband and I are trying to have a quiet evening and I’m reading, I’ll still end up talking or humming, or getting up for little things. I don’t really mean to, but it kind of makes it not very peaceful.
Do you find it hard to stay focused or feel restless even during activities that you enjoy, like watching TV, reading for fun, or talking with friends?

Yes… even when I’m trying to have a quiet evening, like reading next to my husband, I don’t always stay settled. I’ll start talking or humming, or getting up for little things. It ends up making more noise than I mean to, and it’s not as peaceful.
Do you remember feeling this way for as long as you can recall, or is this something that started more recently in your life?

I think it’s been there a long time. Even in elementary school, I was the kid with the messy desk and forgotten permission slips… teachers would send notes saying I talked out of turn or couldn’t stay in my seat. So, no, it doesn’t feel recent.
